nodes.summary: For a modulus $\mathfrak m$ of a number field $K$, the ray-element class map is the group homomorphism from the group of ray elements of $\mathfrak m$ to the ray class group $\mathrm{Cl}_{\mathfrak m}$ that sends $x$ to the ray class of its principal fractional ideal $(x)$, which is coprime to $\mathfrak m$; that is, the principal-ideal map followed by the projection onto the ray class group.
nodes.title: Ray-element class map

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a modulus of a number field $K$ and let $x \in K^\times$ be a ray element of $m$. Then for every finite prime $\mathfrak p$ of $K$ dividing the finite part of $m$, the exponent of $\mathfrak p$ in the principal fractional ideal $x \mathcal O_K$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Ray elements have order zero at the primes dividing the modulus

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a modulus of a number field $K$ and let $x \in K^\times$ be a ray element of $m$. Then for every finite prime $\mathfrak p$ of $K$ dividing the finite part of $m$, the multiplicative $\mathfrak p$-adic valuation of $x$ equals $1$.
nodes.title: Ray elements have valuation one at the primes dividing the modulus

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a modulus of a number field $K$. For every ray element $x$ of $m$, the residue-sign isomorphism of $m$ sends the class of $x$ in the quotient of the ray elements of $m$ by the ray-one subgroup to the image of $x$ under the residue-sign map of $m$.
nodes.title: The residue-sign isomorphism on classes

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a modulus of a number field $K$. The residue-sign isomorphism of $m$ is the group isomorphism from the quotient of the ray elements of $m$ by the ray-one subgroup of $m$ onto the residue-sign target of $m$ induced by the residue-sign map, which is surjective with kernel the ray-one subgroup; it sends the class of a ray element $x$ to the image of $x$ under the residue-sign map.
nodes.title: The residue-sign isomorphism

nodes.summary: Let $\mathfrak m$ be a modulus of a number field $K$, with finite part the nonzero ideal $\mathfrak m_0$ of $\mathcal O_K$. The ray group of $\mathfrak m$ equals the image under the principal ray ideal map of the subgroup of ray-one elements, that is, of the ray elements for $\mathfrak m$ that are congruent to $1$ modulo the finite part of $\mathfrak m$ and positive at every real place in its infinite part.
